before.title: Brand Positioning
before.body: Hyatt Centric is positioned as a urban lifestyle full-service brand driven by location and local exploration. Owner underwriting should prioritize brand-specific fit, demand alignment, and operating-model readiness over Hyatt Hotels Corporation corporate generalizations or sibling-brand assumptions.

after.title: Commercial Differentiator
after.body: Versus Hotel Indigo / Canopy peers, Centric rides World of Hyatt; versus Hyatt Regency, it is explorer lifestyle rather than meetings-led full-service.

block.title: Commercial Differentiator

after.title: Commercial Engine
after.body: Hyatt Centric commercial distribution rides World of Hyatt direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Explorer lifestyle: location-forward urban hotels with neighborhood access and World of Hyatt distribution for travelers who want place over prototype. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.
